blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
blocks.zh: 科学研究中的递归自我改进(RSI)旨在通过自身的实验经验提高代理的研究能力. 科学代理人群可以结合不同研究方向的证据和实施,指导其代理人随后的实验. 然而,糟糕的实验结果可能使假说是否修改或其实施变得不明确,而总体程序分数可以隐藏对其他代理人有用的组件. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了SwarmRSI,这个框架将科学物剂群演变为递归自我改进. 我们设计了以反馈为指南的Swarm Mutation,以利用其他代理人的实验反馈来完善假设及其执行。 我们还提议进行补充性Swarm重组,以重复利用所保留的假说和跨剂的补充程序组件,使部分结果能够支持新的研究。 递归性Swarm Evolution将两种机制融合到反馈循环中,利用新的实验证据来指导后续的研究. 关于OpenProblems,Nature Bench和MLE-Bench Lite的实验展示了SwarmRSI的先进性能(SOTA). 进一步的评价表明,积累的研究经验改善了被搁置任务的业绩。 生物学家还复制其后续生物分析方案。

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents’ research capabilities through their own experimental experience ( Guo et al., 2026a ; Srikanth et al., 2026 ) .
Scientific agent swarms offer a way to pursue this goal by coordinating idea generation, implementation, and evaluation across specialized agents ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .
Persistent memories and shared histories retain experimental experience for later research ( Lyu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Weng et al., 2026 ) , and accumulated histories can also support improvements to exploration strategies ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
Together, these capabilities create an opportunity for agents exploring different directions to use one another’s findings and implementations in subsequent research.
blocks.zh:
科学研究中的递增自修(RSI)旨在通过自身实验经验来提高代理的研究能力(郭等,2026a;斯里坎斯等,2026).
科学代理商群为实现这一目标提供了一种途径,即协调跨专业代理商的思想生成、执行和评价(杨等,2025;唐等,2025;山田等,2025;李等,2026)。
持续的记忆和共享历史保留了后期研究的实验经验(Lyu等,2026;Zhu等,2026;Du等,2026;Weng等,2026),并积累历史也能够支持勘探策略的改进(Zheng等,2026).
这些能力共同为探索不同方向的代理人创造了机会,在以后的研究中利用彼此的调查结果和执行。

blocks.en:
However, sharing experience does not ensure that agents use it to make better research decisions.
Program evolution refines executable candidates through execution feedback ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while hypothesis evolution improves research directions through iterative generation and evaluation ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) .
As Figure 1 illustrates, promising hypotheses are abandoned after inadequate implementations, and useful components are overlooked in programs that perform poorly overall.
blocks.zh:
然而,分享经验并不能确保代理人利用经验作出更好的研究决定。
方案演化通过执行反馈改进了可执行的考生(江等,2025;南等,2025;诺维科夫等,2025;刘等,2025;而假设演化则通过迭代生成和评价改进了研究方向(高特韦斯等,2026;王等,2026a;刘等,2026;龚等,2026).
如图1所示,在执行不足后,放弃了有希望的假设,在总体表现不佳的方案中忽略了有用的组成部分。

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that these limitations arise from two interrelated dependencies in scientific research. The value of a hypothesis depends on how it is implemented and how rigorously it is tested.
An unsuccessful experiment therefore leaves unclear whether the research direction or its implementation needs revision ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Koo et al., 2026 ) , and feedback from other agents identifies which changes are worth pursuing.
Intermediate results also become stepping stones for other search paths ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) , and their value depends on combinations with later findings or implementations.
Their current performance thus underestimates their contribution to other agents’ future research.
This leads to our central question of how scientific agent swarms can evolve toward recursive self-improvement.
blocks.zh:
我们假设,这些局限性产生于科学研究中两个相互关联的依赖。 假设的价值取决于它是如何执行的,以及它的测试有多严格.
因此,一项不成功的实验使研究方向或其实施是否需要修改不清楚(Ma等,2026;Koo等,2026),其他代理人的反馈也表明哪些变化值得追求。
中间结果也成为了其他搜索路径的踏脚石(Wang等,2019;Wang等,2020),其价值取决于与后期发现或执行的结合.
因此,他们目前的表现低估了他们对其他机构未来研究的贡献。
这引出了我们的中心问题,即科学物剂群如何演变成递归自我改进。

blocks.en:
To address this, we introduce SwarmRSI , a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement.
Each agent uses its hypotheses, programs, experimental evidence, and unresolved needs to plan further research, and a shared graph records these inheritable research states.
In Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, agents revise hypotheses and programs using other agents’ experimental feedback.
Performance differences inform hypothesis revision, and unmet research needs guide implementation changes.
In Complementary Swarm Recombination, agents revisit retained hypotheses on other agents’ implementations and combine program components with complementary strengths.
Recursive Swarm Evolution evaluates the resulting candidates, retains useful results, feedback and unresolved needs in the shared graph, and uses these states to decide which hypotheses agents revisit and which programs they refine.
Each experiment thus updates the states that later agents start from.

blocks.en:
We evaluate SwarmRSI on OpenProblems ( Luecken et al., 2025 ) , NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) and MLE-Bench Lite ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , 118 scientific coding and machine-learning engineering tasks, with two backbones.
It achieves SOTA results on OpenProblems and NatureBench and outperforms hypothesis and program evolution agents with the same backbone.
With DeepSeek-V4-Pro in one seed over all 90 NatureBench tasks, about 77% of its final best programs descend from a rebase, a crossover or an update triggered by feedback.
Biologists reproduce two of its programs and use them in follow-up analyses of intestinal and splenic immunity.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM Agents for Scientific Research
blocks.zh: 2.1 LLM 科学研究代理

blocks.en:
LLM agents automate scientific research through hypothesis generation, experiment implementation, and result evaluation ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) .
Agents centred on programs search over or refine code with execution feedback ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ) , R&D-Agent coordinates proposal generation and implementation through specialized roles ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and systems with memory carry execution experience into later experiments ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ) .
Closest to our setting, Arbor links explicit hypotheses to programs and experimental evidence in a persistent hypothesis tree ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , and SAGE evaluates competing failure explanations to direct interventions toward hypotheses, experimental design, or implementation ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . SwarmRSI likewise grounds hypotheses in experiments and lets agents use one another’s feedback and partial results.

blocks.en: 2.2 Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理人自我改进

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement uses an agent’s own experience to improve the mechanisms that guide its subsequent activity.
AIDE 2 retains accepted code modifications as the basis for further self-improvement ( Srikanth et al., 2026 ) , Dream-RSI refines exploration policies with replay simulators built from historical discovery trees ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , MASS alternates workflow evolution with model fine-tuning ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and AQuA uses recorded experiments to guide later research proposals ( Guo et al., 2026a ) .
These methods improve the agent’s code, policy, workflow, or proposals. SwarmRSI instead evolves the research states that agents inherit, revising them with other agents’ feedback and reusing retained hypotheses and program components across agents.

递减自修利用代理人自身的经验来改进指导其随后活动的机制.
AIDE 2保留了被接受的代码修改作为进一步自我改进的基础(Srikanth等,2026年),Dream-RSI用由历史发现树所建的回放模拟器来完善探索政策(郑等,2026年),MASS以模型微调的替代工作流程演化(Lee等,2026年),AQuA使用有记录的实验来指导后期的研究建议(Guo等,2026a). 。 。 。 。
这些方法改进了代理人的代码、政策、工作流程或建议。 SWARMRSI则在研究中演化出代理继承的状态,用其他代理的反馈加以修订,并跨代理重新使用所保留的假设和程序组件.

blocks.en: 4.1 Research Questions
blocks.zh: 4.1 研究问题

blocks.en: We address four research questions and illustrate biological applications through case studies: RQ1 : How does SwarmRSI perform across benchmarks and backbones, and at what token cost? RQ2 : How do Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation, Complementary Swarm Recombination, and Recursive Swarm Evolution contribute to performance? RQ3 : How do experimental feedback and reused intermediate results guide the swarm’s subsequent research within and across tasks? RQ4 : What are the main failure modes, and how frequent are they?

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarks

blocks.en: We evaluate SwarmRSI on scientific coding and machine-learning engineering tasks across three benchmarks. OpenProblems ( Luecken et al., 2025 ) contains six single-cell analysis tasks following TusoAI ( Turcan et al., 2026 ) . NatureBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) contains all 90 scientific coding tasks across six domains. MLE-Bench Lite ( Chan et al., 2025 ) contains 22 competitions from its low-complexity split.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Analysis

blocks.en: • SwarmRSI outperforms domain-specific and general coding agents. blocks.en: • Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation needs both revision modes. Removing H- or P-mutation lowers Match-SOTA by 10.0 and 13.3 pp, respectively. The two modes are complementary, and program repair contributes more. • Complementary Swarm Recombination improves solution quality. Disabling rebase and crossover lowers Match-SOTA by 6.7 pp and Surpass-SOTA from 15.6% to 7.8%, and its drop in mean g g excludes zero. RQ3 traces this gain to reused hypotheses and program components in most final programs. • Recursive Swarm Evolution depends on the shared graph and H/P selection. Match-SOTA drops by 7.8 pp without the shared graph, through which agents use other agents’ records, and by 8.9 pp without H/P selection, which also causes the largest drop in mean g g .

blocks.en: • SwarmRSI recovers more failed implementations and turns more of its hypotheses into improvements. Later refinement turns 35% of failed implementations into new best valid programs, compared with 12% for AIDE and 5% for Arbor. Of its proposed hypotheses, 62% lead to an improvement, against 17% for Arbor. • SwarmRSI revises with prior feedback. In one NatureBench seed with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, updates triggered by performance feedback or unresolved implementation requests reach a 28.4% rate of new bests, against 21.9% over all updates. On 00917, after nine candidates without improvement, two successive hypothesis mutations revise the program’s readout and reach Surpass-SOTA. • SwarmRSI reuses partial results across research trajectories. In the same seed, about 77% of final best programs descend from at least one rebase, crossover or update triggered by feedback, and these updates yield new bests more often than other updates at every stage of search. On 00639, crossover combines components from three programs to reach Match-SOTA, and a later rebase step activates retained message-passing and ranking-loss code that the program had not executed, further improving g g . On 00795, rebase tests an unrealized hypothesis on a later program, and crossover then reuses a component from a program that had not improved overall. • Inherited research states transfer to new tasks. As shown in Section C.2 , the state inherited after three generations of source tasks raises mean g g on 12 held-out NatureBench tasks from 12.01 to 21.89 and Match-SOTA from 41.7% to 86.1% over cold start.

blocks.en: 5.4 Failure Analysis (RQ4)

blocks.en:
We annotate 644 failed attempts from 35 SwarmRSI task trajectories that fall below Match-SOTA on NatureBench or earn no medal on MLE-Bench Lite. Two annotators judge implementation fidelity, execution success and improvement over the preceding best valid result, with Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 . Most failures are faithful interventions without gains. They account for 93.3% of these failures, and implementation or execution problems for 6.7%.
A valid score can hide such a problem, as on task 00838, where downstream code overwrites a proposed amino-acid substitution that the evaluation thus never tests, which is why Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation reads implementation evidence alongside scores. On task 02316, by contrast, a negative-binomial mixture with a Potts spatial prior runs correctly but collapses all locations into one cluster, a faithful intervention without gain.

有效的分数可以隐藏这样一个问题,例如关于00838任务,下游代码覆盖了一种拟议的氨酸替代,因此评价从未进行测试,这就是为什么反馈-Guided Swarm Mutation会将执行证据与分数一并读取的原因. 相比之下,在02316任务上,与Potts空间之前的负-二分位混合运行正确,但将所有位置倒塌成一个集群,这种忠实的干预没有收益.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We began with two obstacles for scientific agent swarms. A failed experiment does not show whether its hypothesis or its implementation was at fault, and a program without overall gains can still hold a component that another agent needs. SwarmRSI addresses both. Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation uses other agents’ feedback to decide whether to revise a hypothesis or repair its program, and Complementary Swarm Recombination carries retained hypotheses and useful components into other agents’ work. Recursive Swarm Evolution returns every outcome to the shared graph, so each experiment changes the states that later agents start from.
It achieves SOTA results on OpenProblems and NatureBench and outperforms baselines with the same backbone, most final NatureBench programs build on such reuse, and biologists reproduce its programs for follow-up analyses of intestinal and splenic immunity.
A swarm thus improves its own research by evolving what its agents inherit.
blocks.zh:
我们从两个障碍开始 科学代理人群。 失败的实验没有显示其假设或执行是否有错,没有总体收益的程序仍然可以持有另一个代理需要的组件. SWARMRSI的地址都是两个。 反馈引导的Swarm Mutation利用其他代理商的反馈来决定是修改假说还是修复其程序,补充Sharm重组将保留假说和有用的组件带入了其他代理商的工作. 递归 Swarm Evolution 将每个结果返回到共享的图中,因此每个实验都会改变后来的代理开始的状态.
它在OpenProblems和Nature Bench上取得了SOTA结果,并且以同样的主干线超越了基线,大多数最终的Nature Bench方案都建立在这种再利用的基础上,生物学家复制了后续分析肠道和脾道免疫的方案.
因此,一群人通过演变其代理人继承的东西来改进自己的研究。

blocks.en:
The execution harness and search controller perform the online audits automatically.
The code audit uses execution status, artifact validity and evaluator feedback to check execution and the task contract.
The scientific audit screens implementation evidence by comparing parent and offspring source code and recorded submitted outputs.
It flags unchanged source or syntax trees, newly added functions without static name references, or identical submitted outputs when comparable output records are available.
The controller uses these source/output flags to gate hypothesis credit.
A valid scored candidate without such a flag receives hypothesis credit ( Potter and De Jong, 2000 ) . Flagged or unscored attempts retain program-level evidence and unresolved implementation requests.
Hypothesis credit records a valid scored candidate passing the source/output checks. Improvement per cost drives H/P selection.
Failed states and states without gain remain available in the graph together with their resulting programs, outcomes, and audit evidence.

blocks.en: C.2 Cross-Task Transfer

blocks.en:
After each generation, the accumulated research state is preserved for subsequent tasks.
This state includes hypotheses, program components, experimental evidence, and unresolved implementation needs.
On a new task, prior records are retrieved by matching their mechanism labels to the task description and initialize the agent’s research state, while candidate programs are adapted and evaluated under the new task’s constraints.

这个状态包括假设,程序组件,实验证据,以及尚未解决的执行需要.
在新的任务中,通过将其机制标签与任务描述相匹配并初始化代理的研究状态来取回先前的记录,而候选程序则在新任务的限制下被调整和评价.

blocks.en:
We run SwarmRSI with DeepSeek-V4-Pro on six NatureBench source tasks in three generations of two tasks each, and each generation starts from the cross-task state exported by the previous one.
We then search 12 held-out NatureBench tasks, fixed in advance and disjoint from the source tasks, from an empty state and from the state after each generation, with three seeds and the same budget per task.
As shown in Table 12 , mean g g rises from 12.01 under cold start to 16.15, 20.16 and 21.89 after one, two and three generations, and Gen 3 improves on cold start by 9.88 points.
Match-SOTA rises from 41.7% to 86.1% and Surpass-SOTA from 33.3% to 58.3%, while tokens per task fall from 12.17M to 10.94M.
Gains are largest over the first two generations, and Gen 3 matches Gen 2 on Match-SOTA and improves mainly through Surpass-SOTA.
Unlike the main experiments described in Section B.7 , some held-out tasks cross the Match-SOTA or Surpass-SOTA threshold in only some seeds, so the rates in Table 12 count the 36 task and seed pairs, for example 31 of 36 for Match-SOTA after Gen 3.
blocks.zh:
我们用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 运行 SwarmRSI 运行着 6 个 Nature Bench 源任务, 共 三代, 每代各有两个任务, 每代从前一代输出的跨任务状态开始 。
然后我们搜索12项被搁置的"自然奔驰"任务,预先确定并与源任务脱节,从空地状态和每代之后的状态,每个任务有3个种子和相同的预算.
如表12所显示,平均克从12.01起从寒冷开始增加到16.15起、20.16起和21.89起,一、二和三代之后,而Gen 3则从寒冷开始提高9.88分。
Match-SOTA从41.7%升至86.1%,Surpass-SOTA从33.3%升至58.3%,而每个任务的代币从12.17M降至10.94M.
前两代所得最多,而Gen 3与Match-SOTA上的Gen 2相匹配,主要通过Surpass-SOTA改进.
与B.7节所描述的主要实验不同,有些被搁置的任务只在某些种子中跨越了Match-SOTA或Surpass-SOTA的阈值,因此表12中的速率计算出36个任务和种子对,例如Gen 3后Match-SOTA的36分之31.

blocks.en: Table 12: Search on 12 held-out NatureBench tasks with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, starting from an empty state (cold start) or from the state inherited after each generation, averaged over three seeds. Match and Surpass are Match-SOTA and Surpass-SOTA rates (%), mean g g is scaled by 100, and Δ ​ g \Delta g is the gain over cold start with a paired task-cluster bootstrap 95% CI from 10,000 resamples. Tokens are means per task in millions.
blocks.zh: 表12:用DeepSeek-V4-Pro搜索了12个被搁置的自然奔驰任务,从空地状态(寒地起步)或从每代后继承的状态开始,平均有3个种子. Match和Surpass为Match-SOTA和Surpass-SOTA的速率(%),正克被缩放为100克;而QQ \Delta g是从冷起的增益,从一万个复标中以一对任务组的靴子带得到95% CI. 以百万计,托肯是每项任务的手段。

blocks.en: Appendix D Human Failure Analysis

blocks.en:
We reviewed 35 failed SwarmRSI task trajectories across NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite.
The annotation unit was an individual attempt, assessed against the best preceding valid result using each benchmark’s metric direction.
The final failure set comprised 644 attempts across these trajectories, after applying the exclusions below.
OpenProblems reports continuous normalized scores without a binary success criterion, so no OpenProblems trajectories enter the failure set.
The 35 trajectories comprise 32 NatureBench tasks below Match-SOTA and 3 MLE-Bench Lite competitions without a medal.
blocks.zh:
我们检视了35个失败的SwarmRSI任务轨迹 跨越了Nature Bench和MLE -Bench Lite.
注释单位是个别的尝试,利用每个基准的衡量方向,根据先前的最佳有效结果进行评估。
最终的失败包括644次尝试,这些尝试在适用了下文的除外规定之后。
OpenProblems报告连续常态分数,没有二进制成功标准,因此没有OpenProblems轨迹输入失败设置.
35道包括Match-SOTA以下的32道"自然奔驰"任务和3道没有奖牌的"MLE-Bench Lite"比赛.

blocks.en:
Annotators examined the proposed intervention, implementation and execution records, evaluator outputs, and preceding scores. Implementation or execution failure denotes an intervention that could not be reliably tested because of code or interface errors, execution interruptions, or proposal–implementation mismatches. No performance gain denotes a faithfully implemented and executed intervention with a valid evaluation that did not improve the preceding best valid result.
Equal scores were treated as no gain.
Recovered intermediate errors were judged by the final evaluated outcome.
Successful verification or restoration of an existing result, and repetition of an attained metric ceiling, were excluded from the failure counts.
Attempts with insufficient evidence to distinguish the two failure classes were also excluded.
blocks.zh:
注释者审查了拟议的干预、执行和执行记录、评价产出和先前的分数。 执行或执行失败是指由于代码或界面出错,执行中断,或建议-执行不匹配而无法可靠测试的干预. 任何业绩收益均不表示忠实实施和执行的干预措施具有有效的评价,没有改善先前的最佳有效结果。
相等分被视作无益.
已追回的中间错误由最后评价结果判断。
成功核查或恢复现有结果和重复达到的衡量上限被排除在失败计数之外。
没有充分证据证明这两类失败的尝试也被排除在外。

blocks.en: Two annotators with PhDs in bioinformatics engineering reviewed the evidence using these criteria, with inter-rater agreement of Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 .
blocks.zh: 两位拥有生物信息学工程博士学位的注释员利用这些标准审查了证据,结果科恩的成绩一致=0.92\kappa=0.92。

blocks.en:
On task 00838, a proposed amino-acid substitution was overwritten by downstream rules, leaving the evaluated output unchanged This was an implementation failure despite a valid score.
In contrast, on task 02316, a negative-binomial mixture with a Potts spatial prior ran successfully but collapsed all locations into one cluster, yielding ARI zero. This was a no-gain outcome.
blocks.zh:
关于00838号任务,一项拟议的氨基酸替代被下游规则所取代,使评价的产出保持不变 尽管得分有效,但执行失败。
与此相反,在02316任务上,一个带有Potts空间的前作的负-二分位混合物成功运行,但将所有位置倒塌成一个集群,产生ARI 0. 这是一无是处的结果。

blocks.en: E.1 Enterocyte: Infection-Associated Expression Variation
blocks.zh: E.1 肠道:感染-结合表达方式变化

blocks.en:
NatureBench task s41592-023-01955-3 is associated with contrastiveVI ( Weinberger et al., 2023 ) and returns a low-dimensional target-cell representation.
The program selected by SwarmRSI comes from step 4 of five recorded steps.
Its recorded task-level g = 1.838461 g=1.838461 averages the Haber, McFarland and Norman instances.
The analysis here concerns only the Haber intestinal instance ( Haber et al., 2017 ) , GEO GSE92332.
The public matrix contains 9,842 cells and 15,215 genes: 3,240 healthy background cells, 2,711 helminth day-10 and 1,770 Salmonella target cells, and 2,121 helminth day-3 cells outside the target submission.
The published Enterocyte annotation selects 1,458 cells, including 833 targets (128 helminth day-10 and 705 Salmonella).
blocks.zh:
Nature Bench task s41592-023-01955-3与对比VI(Weinberger等,2023年)相接并返回了低维目标细胞代表.
SwarmRSI所选择的程序来自有记录的五个步骤中的第四步.
其记录的任务等级为g=1.838461克=1.838461,平均为哈伯、麦克法兰和诺曼等地。
这里的分析只涉及哈伯肠病(Haber等,2017年),GEO GSE92332.
公共基质包含有9,842个细胞和15,215个基因:3,240个健康背景细胞,2,711个盘状天-10和1,770个沙门尼拉靶细胞,2,121个盘状天-3细胞在目标提交外.
已出版的"Enterocyte注释"选取了1,458个细胞,包括833个目标(128个Crapinth day-10和705个Salmonella).

blocks.en:
For Haber, the program normalizes total counts to 10,000 and applies log1p, selects 2,000 genes by variance across target and background cells, and standardizes using background means and standard deviations, clipping at ± 10 \pm 10 .
It identifies 20 healthy neighbours per target in a 50-dimensional background PCA space and subtracts their mean expression.
A singular-value decomposition yields a 20-dimensional residual space. A 15-neighbour graph then smooths the first ten residual coordinates for two iterations, including a self weight.
Experts reproduced the program. Local-coherence analysis uses its ten-dimensional outputs.
The embedding is constructed from RNA, and infection labels parsed from public cell identifiers are used for diagnostic silhouette reporting.
blocks.zh:
对哈伯来说,程序将总数正常化为一万个并应用了log1p,通过目标细胞和背景细胞之间的差异选择了2000个基因,并利用背景手段和标准偏差进行标准化,剪接时间为±10\pm 10.
它在50个背景的PCA空间中确定每个目标20个健康邻居,并减去其平均值.
单值分解产生20维残相. 15相邻的图再将前10个剩余坐标平滑为两个迭代,包括自重.
专家转载了该方案。 局部一致性分析使用其十维输出.
嵌入由RNA所构建,从公共细胞识别器中解析出感染标签用于诊断 silhouette报告.

blocks.en:
Each program score is the arithmetic mean of its genes’ log ⁡ ( 1 + 10 4 ​ x / ∑ x ) \log(1+10^{4}x/\sum x) expression.
The MHC-II-associated set is Cd74, H2-Aa, H2-Ab1 and H2-Eb1 (the input matrix uses dots in the H2 gene names).
The interferon set is Stat1, Isg15, Ifit1, Ifit3, Oas1a and Irf7. All six genes are present in the matrix.
The antimicrobial set contains Reg3g, Reg3b, Lcn2 and Saa1. Its signal is dominated by Reg3g/Reg3b, with Lcn2 undetected and Saa1 low in these enterocytes.
B1–B4 are control sources, B5/B6 helminth day 3, B7/B8 helminth day 10, and B9/B10 Salmonella.
Source labels denote sequencing batches. Figure 8 shows that the four MHC-II genes each have higher source means in B7/B8 than in B9/B10.
The antimicrobial program means are 2.120 and 3.158 in B7/B8 versus 3.114 and 3.130 in B9/B10, showing a source-dependent contrast. Table 13 reports MHC-II and interferon means for all ten sources.
Pooling enterocytes within each condition gives MHC-II means of 1.168 in helminth day 10, 0.335 in Salmonella and 0.202 in controls.
The corresponding interferon means are 0.356, 0.438 and 0.150.
These condition means weight each source by its enterocyte count.

每个程序得分是其基因的对数的算术平均值 QQ (1 + 10 4 x / ∑ x)\log (1 + 10 + 4}x/\ sum x) 表达.
MHC-II相关集为Cd74,H2-Aa,H2-Ab1和H2-Eb1(输入矩阵在H2基因名中使用点).
干涉器集为:Stat1,Isg15,Ifit1,Ifit3,Oas1a和Irf7. 所有六个基因都存在于基质中.
该套抗微生物药含有Reg3g,Reg3b,Lcn2和Saa1. 其信号以Reg3g/Reg3b为主,Lcn2未被探测到,而Saa1在这些入门管中也很低.
B1–B4是控制源,B5/B6舵天3,B7/B8舵天10,和B9/B10沙门氏菌.
源标签表示顺序批次. 图8显示,四个MHC-II基因在B7/B8中各拥有比在B9/B10中更高的源入量.
B7/B8中的抗微生物方案手段为2.120和3.158,而B9/B10中的抗微生物方案手段为3.114和3.130,显示出了依赖源的对比. 表13报告所有10个来源的MHC-II和Interferon。
在每个条件中,聚入肠管使MHC-II在舵手第10天为1.168个,沙门氏菌为0.335个,控制为0.202个。
相应的干涉手段有:0.356,0.438和0.150.
这些条件意味着每个来源按其肠道分数的重量。

blocks.en:
Measured RNA and the reproduced representation are matched by cell identifier.
Within each of B7–B10, the analysis selects ten neighbours among cells of the same Enterocyte type and source, excludes the focal cell, and correlates its program score with the neighbours’ mean score using Spearman’s ρ \rho . Figure 7 reports these unadjusted correlations.
Sensitivity checks use five and fifteen neighbours and the representation saved from the original SwarmRSI run.
For covariate sensitivity, each program score is regressed within source on an intercept, log1p total UMI, log1p detected genes and the mean absorptive-marker score (Alpi, Apoa1, Fabp1, Fabp2, Sis). Table 14 reports the same correlation using the residual score and the mean residual of the fixed ten neighbours.
Local coherence quantifies measured RNA structure retained in each RNA-derived representation.

所测量的RNA和所复制的表示值相匹配为单元格标识符.
在B7-B10中,分析在同一个 Enterocyte 类型和源的细胞中选择了十个相邻的细胞,不包括焦细胞,并且用 Spearman 的 $\rho 将其程序得分与相邻的正分相挂钩。 图7报告了这些未经调整的相互关系。
敏感度检查使用5个和15个邻居,以及从原SwarmRSI运行中节省下来的代表.
对于共变灵敏度,每个程序得分在源内被递回到一个截取,log1p总UMI,log1p检测到的基因和平均吸收-标记分数(Alpi, Apoa1, Fabp1, Fabp2, Sis)上. 表14以10个固定邻居的剩余分数和平均剩余数报告同样的关联性。
局部一致性将每个RNA衍生代表中保留的测量RNA结构量化.

Reproduced/recorded outputs are the expert reproduction and the representation saved from the original SwarmRSI run. Counts are cells per source.

blocks.en: E.2 CytoCommunity: Spatial Context and Protein Follow-up
blocks.zh: E.2 社区:空间背景和蛋白质后续

blocks.en: Figure 9: Expert follow-up of B-cell neighbourhoods across three spleen images. E1–E3 are post-hoc groups defined by local cell composition. (a) Their proportions among B cells in the manually annotated marginal zone. (b) All six primary protein contrasts after within-image spatial/phenotype matching, E2 minus E1 in that zone (815, 995 and 1,025 pairs). Points are standardized transformed-protein differences. Intervals are 95% within-image spatial-block bootstrap intervals.

blocks.en:
NatureBench task s41592-023-02124-2 uses three healthy mouse spleen CODEX images associated with CytoCommunity ( Hu et al., 2024 ) : 82,382, 81,925 and 80,973 cells, respectively, with 27 supplied cell phenotypes. SwarmRSI receives coordinates and phenotype labels. The expert follow-up separately examines measured protein intensities.
The program selected by SwarmRSI comes from step 12 of a 15-step search and raises g g from 0.04507 to 0.10215.
It uses phenotype-derived anatomical priors, 50-neighbour composition and interface features, Gaussian EM, an anatomically constrained spatial MRF and cleanup of components smaller than 150 cells.
Recorded macro-F1 and AMI are 0.639247 and 0.583341. Macro-F1 includes the unannotated reference category, whose F1 is zero.
Marginal-zone F1 is 0.600, 0.593 and 0.635.
blocks.zh:
Nature Bench任务 s41592-023-02124-2使用与CytoCommunity(Hu等,2024年)相接的3个健康鼠脾CODEX图像:分别为82,382个,81,925个和80,973个细胞,共提供了27个细胞的酚类. SWARMRSI接收坐标和酚类标签. 专家后续单独检查所测量的蛋白质强度.
SwarmRSI所选择的程序出自15步搜索的第12步,将克从0.04507提高到0.10215.
它使用苯基衍生出解剖前科,50-邻接成分和界面特征,高斯能电解解解解解,解剖受限的空间MRF并清理出小于150个细胞的成分.
记录的宏-F1和AMI为0.639247和0.583341. 宏-F1包括了无注释的参考类,其F1为零.
边缘区F1为0.600,0.593和0.635.

blocks.en:
The analysis includes 35,168, 33,544 and 32,451 conventionally annotated B cells (101,163 total).
Experts fit three exploratory neighbourhood-composition prototypes in the first image and then hold them fixed for the other two, giving B/FDC-rich (E1), myeloid/erythroid-rich (E2) and T-cell-rich (E3) groups.
E1–E3 describe local cell composition around B cells in this post-hoc analysis. They are distinct from the program’s anatomical partitions.
The primary comparison uses E2 versus E1 within the manual marginal zone, independently of whether the SwarmRSI program assigned that cell to the marginal zone.
Coordinates are analyzed in dataset units.
blocks.zh:
分析包括35 168个、33 544个和32 451个常规注解的B组(共计101 163个)。
专家将三个探索性的邻里组合原型装入了第一个图像,然后将其固定在另外两个图像上,使B/FDC富含(E1)、myeloid/红外行星富含(E2)和T细胞富含(E3)组。
E1-E3在这个后热分析中描述了B细胞周围的局部细胞组成. 它们与程序解剖分割是不同的。
主比较在手动边区内使用E2与E1,独立于SwarmRSI程序是否将该细胞分配给边区.
坐标按数据集单位分析.

blocks.en:
The analysis uses processed protein measurements for all 245,280 cells.
Within each image and manual marginal zone, matching is exact on original phenotype cluster and imaging tile, then uses five geometry variables with a 0.5-SD per-variable caliper, joint distance at most 1 and no replacement.
There are 815, 995 and 1,025 matched E2–E1 pairs, retaining 42.5%, 46.2% and 41.1% of E2 cells, respectively.
Maximum absolute geometry standardized mean differences are 0.080, 0.063 and 0.083. Protein contrasts use this matched overlap subset.
All six preselected proteins (CD79b, B220, IgD, IgM, MHCII, CD44) are shown in Figure 9 b.
Measurements are transformed as arcsinh ⁡ ( x / 150 ) \operatorname{arcsinh}(x/150) , retaining negative values. Effects are differences of transformed means divided by the within-image contrast-population standard deviation.
Intervals use 1,000 bootstrap resamples of 1,000-coordinate-unit spatial blocks within each image.
B220 effects are + 0.082 +0.082 , − 0.130 -0.130 and − 0.190 -0.190 . Stricter 0.25-SD matching also yields inconsistent directions.
In spatially blocked validation, adding neighbourhood labels to a geometry/phenotype protein predictor produces Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} from − 0.00098 -0.00098 to + 0.00967 +0.00967 across 18 image–protein combinations.
Neighbourhood labels add little predictive information for these six protein markers in spatially blocked validation.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en:
SwarmRSI requires an evaluator that can execute candidate programs, so research without executable feedback is outside its scope.
Execution feedback does not always reveal whether the intended intervention was faithfully implemented, and performance gains alone do not establish its scientific mechanism.
Rebase selects program bases by matching recorded implementation needs to program mechanism labels, a heuristic that does not measure what a program can do.
Crossover applies only when a benchmark reports scores per instance.
H/P selection adapts discounted UCB without inheriting its guarantees, and its benefit is established only empirically.
blocks.zh:
SWARMRSI需要一位可以执行候选程序的评价师,因此没有可执行反馈的研究在其范围之外.
执行反馈并不总是能揭示计划采取的干预措施是否得到忠实执行,单靠绩效收益并不能建立其科学机制.
通过匹配记录的执行需求来重新建立程序基础来选择程序机制标签,这种heuristic是不衡量程序所能做的.
只有在基准报告每例得分时才适用交叉。
H/P选择在不继承其担保的情况下对折扣的UCB进行调整,其好处仅以经验为依据确定.

blocks.en:
Evaluation covers comparisons under matched budgets on three benchmark families.
The human failure analysis characterizes 644 annotated failed attempts from 35 task trajectories.
Cross-task evidence comes from six source tasks, 12 held-out tasks and one backbone, and generations are confounded with the number of source tasks seen.
blocks.zh:
评价包括三个基准家庭在对应预算下的比较。
人类失败分析的特点是,35个任务轨迹中的644个附加说明的失败尝试.
跨任务证据出自6个源任务,12个被搁置任务和1个骨干,世代对所见到的源任务数量感到困惑.

blocks.en:
The evaluation does not separately assess literature synthesis ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , idea quality ( Sauter et al., 2026 ) , or peer-review quality ( Guo et al., 2026b ) .
Generalization to complete research workflows ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Schmidgall et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) and information-access agents ( Kanoulas et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) requires additional evaluation.
blocks.zh:
该评价不单独评估文献综合(Shi等,2025年),思想质量(Sauter等,2026年),或同行评审质量(Guo等,2026年b).
普及以完成研究工作流程 (Lu等,2024;Schmidgall等,2025;Lyu等,2026)和信息获取剂(Kanoulas等,2025;Cao等,2026)需要额外的评价.

blocks.en:
Other untested settings include legal reasoning ( Lyu et al., 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2023a ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , zero-shot entity extraction ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , conversational recommendation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and shopping research ( Lyu et al., 2025c ) .
These settings require task-specific objectives and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh:
其他未经测试的环境包括法律推理(Lyu等,2022;Lyu等,2023a; Wu等,2023年),零射取出实体(Wang等,2025年),谈话推荐(张等,2024年),购物研究(Lyu等,2025c.
这些设置需要特定任务的目标和评价协议.

blocks.en: Appendix G Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 附录G 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
Benchmark gains do not establish factual reliability or alignment with human preferences, which require separate evaluation and optimization ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2024a ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Lyu et al., 2025b ) .
We do not assess robustness to dataset shortcuts ( Lyu et al., 2023b ) , social stereotypes ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , or cognitive biases ( Lyu et al., 2024b ; Lyu et al., 2025a ) , nor do we test harmful-content generation.
Applications that affect people should preserve user agency and provide domain-appropriate human oversight ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
基准收益没有确定实际可靠性或与人类偏好相一致,这需要单独评价和优化(Lin等,2022;Lyu等,2024a;Rafailov等,2023;Lyu等,2025b)。
我们没有评估数据集快捷方式(Lyu等人,2023年b),社会陈规定型观念(Parrish等人,2022年),或认知偏见(Lyu等人,2024年b;Lyu等人,2025年a),也没有测试有害内容生成。
影响群众的应用应当保留用户代理,并提供适合域的人类监督(张等,2025.

blocks.en:
Generated programs and scientific interpretations require independent validation before use beyond the benchmark setting.
The execution and scientific audits check task validity and implementation evidence; they do not certify security or scientific correctness.
The biological case studies analyse existing datasets, and their associations do not establish causal mechanisms or clinical validity.
Any deployment should restrict code execution, external-tool access and credentials to the approved scope, and review proposed uses for potential harm.
blocks.zh:
生成的程序和科学解释需要独立验证,然后使用超越基准设定.
执行和科学审计检查任务有效性和执行证据;不证明安全性或科学正确性。
生物案例研究分析现有数据集,其关联没有建立因果机制或临床有效性.
任何部署都应将代码执行、外部工具访问和证书限制在核定范围内,并审查潜在损害的拟议用途。

blocks.en:
Data reuse should respect source licences, access restrictions and privacy requirements, with provenance and intended uses documented ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) .
We report time budgets, hardware configurations and token consumption to support resource-aware comparisons ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ) .
Token consumption is not a direct measurement of energy use or carbon emissions.
blocks.zh:
数据再利用应遵守源许可证、访问限制和隐私要求,并注明来源和预期用途(Gebru等人,2021年)。
我们报告时间预算、硬件配置和象征性消耗,以支持资源意识比较(Schwartz等,2020年)。
消费不是对能源使用或碳排放的直接衡量。
